selection.rule: Confirm the frozen nominee without switching to a different screen policy based on confirmation noise.

complete.resumption: User requested continuation after reboot; fresh confirmation excludes all historical interrupted-cohort endpoints.

resumption.reason: Host reboot after unfinished trial; preserve all eight completed endpoints but exclude the entire interrupted confirmation cohort from promotion. Restart all frozen arms in three complete fresh blocks. No performance-based exclusions.

old_spec.scope: Fresh independent full-request confirmation; five arms include both DSO-free and full-incumbent RPC changes. No PMU.
old_spec.budget_rule: Four blocks if confirmation starts by13:55UTC, otherwise three; fixed before first confirmation endpoint.

resumption.platform_note: No claim of normal restoration for the reboot-interrupted trial. New trials snapshot and restore the post-boot platform state.

training_classification.scope: Earlier full-policy residual L2 retired PEBS training, request-normalized across nine app processes. Not raw L2 code-read events, kernel counts, or independent held-out coverage.
training_classification.limitation: Outside main includes loaded DSOs. Not-original-instruction means no decoded instruction at that address in the original ELF; do not equate every such sample with a generated stub without address-range verification.

training_stub_audit.scope: Retained incumbent training, not new-policy PMU or a held-out temporal trace.
training_stub_audit.interpretation: PEBS sample IP is inside an emitted prefetch-stub range. This is not the number of misses caused by prefetch targets, a slowdown estimate, or a BTB attribution. Ranges come from the incumbent patch records; no decoded copies are retained.

pmu.scope: MovieId, ComposeReview and Rating only; each service/event group has a separate three-second request-normalized window. Pool user/kernel counts are separate and not additive to service counts. One diagnostic per arm, no PMU confidence intervals. No throughput/latency inference from diagnostic trials.

decision.rule: Promote only the frozen RPC nominees with positive lower individual paired-log throughput CI versus their own background policy, CPU cost <=+0.5%, and p99 cost <=+2%. Intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted; do not select a different RPC implementation from confirmation.
